'''Sounac''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Undercity]]. After a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] flown by a group of [[Believers]] crashed in the Undercity, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that were pursuing it arrived shortly afterwards and Krood was among a group including the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Ilok]], the [[Coruscani ogre]] [[Bartle]] and the Trandoshans [[Dure]] and [[Krood]], who attacked them.
